controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 clear-filter imagery registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Measured sky-background subtraction and bounded illumination correction reduce photographed shading. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. The distant hemisphere and cast shadows are not reconstructed.
controls.title: Clear-filter mosaic
controls.summary: Brightness is corrected for illumination. The gray grid marks the unseen side, withheld shadows and unreliable samples.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 96 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Voyager-derived shape model. Shows the broad irregular shape, not local height above a geoid. The archived 5° radius grid includes modeled unseen terrain and can exaggerate facets or depressions. Small craters are not resolved.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Height relative to a 96 km sphere, from a Voyager shape model. Unseen terrain is modeled; small features are uncertain.
